resolution: The rule states the engine behaviour with basis engine. The owner ruling of 2026-08-22 (“Negating an effect REMOVES it from…”) implements that reading for Finality (its second sentence erases the cards its first sentence just negated) and asks the owner to rule, because it makes the card stronger (D-U14-6, merged here). Sign-off: the order in general, and Finality's reading in particular.

summary: The owner ruling of 2026-08-18 (“"Whenever you play a unit" includes…”) says Bloomcaster's trigger fires on its own play and dates itself to the 2026-07-16 engine. The current engine hears plays only from cards in play, and a played card is on the stack, not in play, when its play fires; the designer write-up describes that state for Mycelial Mentor. The engine now makes no 1/1 for Bloomcaster's own play (F-U14-5 (CT-254)).

sides.quote: Bloomcaster's "[Augment] Whenever you play a unit" (no "another") **fires on its own

Whenever you play a unit

resolution: Answered by the owner on 2026-10-11, reading B (the owner ruling of 2026-10-11 (“"Whenever you play a unit" does…”), reversing the owner ruling of 2026-08-18 (“"Whenever you play a unit" includes…”)’s own-play half): a card being played is on the stack, not in play, so its own "whenever you play a unit" does not hear it. The rule states B. The engine already does B for Bloomcaster, so the findings that called that a bug (F-U14-5, F-U14-8) are closed and CT-254 closes as not a bug. Stalwart Sentinel, which heard its own play from a bin (F-U14-10), and the other cards that did were fixed on 2026-10-11 (CT-277).
